purpose: Machine-readable catalog of Gmail connector commands used by the manager agent.
source_of_truth: Connected Gmail app connector, refreshed through tool_search on 2026-05-29.

read_only_tools.use_for: Label names, label IDs, inbox/unread/draft counts, and user-label discovery.
notes: Use labels[].id for label filters when a tool expects IDs.

read_only_tools.use_for: Primary Gmail search with summaries, labels, attachment metadata, display URLs, and pagination.
notes: Put Gmail search operators in query, not label_ids.

read_only_tools.use_for: Compact message-ID retrieval for batch reads or owner-approved mutations.
notes: Do not pass placeholders, subjects, email addresses, draft IDs, or Gmail URLs as IDs.

read_only_tools.use_for: Read multiple exact messages by Gmail message ID.
notes: Summarize private content; do not store raw bodies.

read_only_tools.use_for: Fetch one complete conversation before drafting, forwarding, tasking, or deciding.
notes: Use id_type=thread only for true thread IDs.
Split mixed message/thread IDs into separate calls.

read_only_tools.use_for: Inspect draft summaries without changing or sending them.
notes: Draft edits/sends still need explicit owner approval.

read_only_tools.use_for: Fetch one attachment selected from parent-message attachment metadata.
notes: Prefer attachment_id; use exact filename only when attachment_id is absent.
Drafts with attachments are not editable through this action.
Inspect current attachment_files schema before sending; pass absolute local path(s) in the active shape.

safe_default_workflows: list labels for counts and label IDs
search summaries with narrow Gmail query syntax
read the exact message or thread before summarizing or drafting
read attachments only when the owner asks or the task requires the attachment
preview bulk Gmail queries before server-side label/archive changes
extract only durable decisions, deadlines, tasks, approvals, and operating notes into manager memory
do not store full email bodies, raw threads, private attachments, or one-off newsletters in manager memory
known_connector_limits: tool availability and attachment_files shape can vary by active Gmail surface; inspect current schema before sending
some Russian or supplier message bodies may decode as mojibake
newsletter and marketing messages can return very large noisy bodies
has:attachment may surface inline images or calendar-style noise, so inspect attachment metadata before reading files
connector-parsed PDF text may be garbled; use PDF/document rendering for final document work

verification_record.method: tool_search metadata plus recent owner-approved Gmail operations in this project
